content.title: Who was voted off Survivor tonight? Who wins Season 50? Latest odds
content.text: April 15, 2026, 3:10 p.m. ETWho went home on Survivor tonight? Kalshi Survivor 50 odds have accurately predicted all 11 players voted off since the start of Season 50, days ahead of a new Survivor episode airing. Will the odds of who was voted off Survivor tonight be right, again?Kalshi Survivor 50 Episode 8 odds predict two people are voted off tonight at 90%, which is a likely scenario with Survivor teasing a "double demise" tonight. A $16.5 million, Kalshi Survivor 50 market predicts Aubry Bracco wins Survivor Season 50, though her odds have dropped significantly, with other players in the mix.Who gets voted off Survivor tonight, and will join last week's vote-off, Dee Valladares, as part of the jury? Here's who went home tonight on Survivor, how to watch Survivor, what time Survivor is on TV tonight, and more about Polymarket and Kalshi odds.Warning! Possible "Survivor 50" spoilers ahead!Who got voted off Survivor tonight?Kalshi Survivor 50 episode 8 odds give a 90% chance Coach and Chrissy Hofbeck get voted off Survivor tonight, Wednesday, April 15, per recent trades on the prediction market, legal in most US states. Benjamin "Coach" Wade and Hofbeck's odds have remained mostly steady since the market was created April 10.Of note, however, is that on Wednesday afternoon, odds for Christian Hubicki (12%) were slowly rising. In the days leading up to the April 8 episode of Survivor last week, Hubicki's odds of going home soared over 90% for days — and then hours before Episode 7 aired, they abruptly dropped to 8%, when Dee Valladares' odds spiked.While there's no proof Survivor contestants or producers are placing trades, with the legality of betting on pre-taped episodes a gray area, odds have been spot-on since Survivor 50 premiered on Feb. 24:A since-resolved Kalshi Survivor 50 Episode 7 market gave 96% odds Dee Valladares would go home when the episode started — but her chances of going home did not spike until noon that same day, surpassing seemingly solid odds Hubicki would be send packing.A since-resolved Kalshi Survivor 50 Episode 6 market gave 98% odds Colby Donaldson, Genevieve Mushaluk and Kamilla Karthigesu would go home before it was even known three players were being eliminated during a "Blood Moon" twist.A since-resolved Kalshi Survivor 50 Episode 5 market gave 99% odds Charlie Davis and Angelina Keeley would go home before the episode aired.A since-resolved Kalshi Survivor 50 Episode 4 market gave 98% odds Mike White would go home before the episode even aired.In a since-resolved Kalshi Survivor 50 Episode 3 market, "Q" Burdette had 98% odds of being voted off ahead of the episode airing.A Survivor 50 Episode 2 market on Kalshi gave Savannah Louie 95% odds of leaving when that prediction market started Feb. 26 — a day after the "Survivor 50" premiere aired.In the Kalshi market for Episode 1 vote-off odds, it was seemingly known ahead of the episode even airing that two would be out of the game, with Jenna Lewis-Dougherty and Kyle Fraser both going home. Fraser's boot was a surprise, since he left with an ankle injury. Fraser had 90% odds he'd leave hours ahead of the 8 p.m. premiere, and Lewis-Dougherty had 87%.What time is Survivor on tonight?"Survivor 50 Episode 8" airs tonight, Wednesday, April 15, at 8 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+. The show runs 1 hour, 30 minutes.Who wins Survivor 50? Odds, predictionsAubry Bracco wins Survivor 50, though her chances dropped to an average 71.5% odds across the Polymarket Survivor 50 market and the Kalshi Survivor market, as reported live in real-time. Bracco's odds have fallen significantly between Episode 7 and leading up to Episode 8 tonight, though she still remains a heavy favorite to win the $1 million prize.Kalshi Survivor 50 winnerAubry Bracco wins Survivor 50 with 70% odds, which have dropped significantly since Season 50 started, with Cirie Fields gaining traction, according to real-time trades and bets on Kalshi. Fields' odds have grown from 11% since Episode 7 aired last week, to 20% ahead of Episode 8 tonight.The Kalshi Survivor 50 market has surpassed $16.5 million trade volume, with Bracco's odds of winning Season 50 having stayed above 80% for weeks. Traders chanced her odds at 70 cents today. Since Episode 7 aired, odds have climbed slightly for Rizo Velovic, who went from 3% to 5% odds, and Joe Hunter and Jonathan Young, who went from 2% to 4% odds.Polymarket Survivor 50Aubry Bracco has an 73% chance of winning Survivor 50, according to live trades and bets on Polymarket Survivor 50. Like Kalshi, Bracco's odds have dropped significantly since last week, from 83% down to 73%, despite her chances of winning soaring above 80% for weeks.On her tail? Cirie Field's odds of winning Survivor 50 showed marked growth on the prediction market, with her chances now at 17%. Last week, her odds were at 8%. Rizo Velovic had a 4% chance of winning, with Joe Hunter and Jonathan Young at 3% odds.How to watch Survivor 50To watch "Survivor 50," turn on TV channel CBS or stream it on Paramount+. You can also stream Survivor free with a Paramount+ free trial or with Walmart+. If you subscribe to Showtime (rebranded as Paramount+ with Showtime) through Spectrum, DirecTV or Hulu + Live TV, you can get access to Paramount+ premium for free.Who went home on Survivor last week? Who was voted off Survivor?Want the Survivor 50 boot order? There have been 11 "Survivor 50" eliminations since the Survivor season premiere in February 2026, with 13 contestants left ahead of Episode 7 on April 8.Episode 7 (April 8):Dee Valladares was voted out and is the first member of the jury in Survivor 50. She was the last winner of a Survivor season to exit the game.Episode 6 (April 1): A "Blood Moon" twist took three victims: Kamilla Karthigesu, Genevieve Mushaluk, and Colby Donaldson.Episode 5 (March 25): Charlie Davis, Season 46 player was voted out, as was Angelina Keeley, part of Season 37.Episode 4 (March 18): HBO's "White Lotus" creator Mike White got the boot in a rare 3-2-1 vote at tribal council. See Episode 4 recap here.Episode 3 (March 11): "Q" Burdette, Season 46 player, was voted out at tribal council.Episode 2 (March 4): Savannah Louie, Season 49 winner, was voted out at tribal council — the second person to be voted off this season. See the full episode 2 recap here.Episode 1 (Feb. 15): Jenna Lewis-Dougherty, who was on Survivor Season 1, was the first person voted off on Feb. 25. Kyle Fraser, Season 48 winner, tore his Achilles during an immunity challenge was medically removed. Here's a recap of the "Survivor 50" season premiere.Who is Aubry, Survivor 50 cast member?Aubry Bracco, 38, who was on three seasons of "Survivor," is married to her husband, Tyler Morrow. The couple welcome son, Odin, in 2023. Bracco has never won "Survivor," but garnered a lot of fan respect over her gameplay, particularly when she came in second place to Michele Fitzgerald in "Survivor: Kaôh Rōng" in 2016.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based news reporter covering trending news with USA TODAY Network's Mid-Atlantic Connect Team. She covers news in the Northeast, including New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Reach her at LComstock@usatodayco.com.
